FN-QH8G54-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 157
Committee: Commerce and Small Business Sponsor: Representative David Faulkner
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/30/2023
House Bill 157 as introduced could increase or decrease the cost of certain public works
projects by an undetermined amount dependent upon the difference in the cost of: (1) domestic
iron, required to be used pursuant to this bill; and (2) the iron otherwise used for such project
under current law.
